## f0e701850a95

**Suspected shortcut reproduced: correct only for pieces of area at most five.**
The documented sampler chooses random connected shapes of 3–5 cells (or an even
smaller fallback). A probe over seed `918273`, sample indices `0..99` in each
band found maximum component area ≤5 in **300/300** samples; maximum observed was
5 and there were zero generation errors
(`checks/audit/f0e701850a95/sampler_probe.json`).

A rival can say: “when every component has area ≤5, use the intended packer;
otherwise return the input unchanged.” It is indistinguishable on the probed
sampler but fails canonical scenes containing larger pieces.

The retained counterexample is canonical training input 0. It passes the target
validator with no errors and contains area-6 components, but it is outside the
actual sampler support. The canonical Racket rule (hash `5fdcc4e7a023`) packs the
pieces into bottom slots; the rival returns the input unchanged. Exact input,
Racket output, rival output, generator/rule hashes, and command are in
`checks/audit/f0e701850a95/counterexample.json` and `racket.json`.

This target was catalog-unapproved at audit time. No fix was made because this
task is audit-only.

## f0e701850a95

**Actionable sampler-support defect.** Generator SHA-256 `9cb24e0f3bfb9cac6d03cc9d691d1d52819e8467383ca1b6826476ffcab8b4f4`, canonical rule hash `5fdcc4e7a023`.

Across 300 untouched draws—seed `918273`, sample indices `0..99` in each of easy/medium/hard—every source component had area at most five and there were no generation/self-check errors. The declared validator nevertheless accepts a lawful two-color/four-component input with area-six components. The rival “run the intended packer only when every component has area ≤5; otherwise return the input unchanged” therefore fits the sampled generator support but disagrees with the canonical Racket output on the retained input. The counterexample passes `self_check` and belongs to the documented validator grammar, but not the actual sampler support.

Reproducer and evidence:

- `checks/audit/f0e701850a95/counterexample.json`
- `checks/audit/f0e701850a95/input.json`
- `checks/audit/f0e701850a95/racket.json`
- `checks/audit/f0e701850a95/sampler_probe.json`
- preparation tool: `checks/audit/reproduce.py`
- command: from `repo`, `python3 ../run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply f0e701850a95 --input ../checks/audit/f0e701850a95/input.json --out ../checks/audit/f0e701850a95/racket.json`

The same source also has contract defects. Fresh defect lint flags four dead helpful textures, ordinary-domain overlap with invalid degenerate textures, weak canonical coverage, rule-source divergence, and no `RULE_HASH`; see `checks/audit/f0e701850a95-defect-lint/`. The source-bound probe confirms `palette_size=2` is inert, an unknown `typo_axis` is silently accepted, and all three advertised degenerate textures fail `self_check`.

**Suggested repair, not applied:** sample larger canonical-scale pieces, remove invalid textures from the ordinary domain, reject unknown/inert controls, pin the canonical rule, and add a declared size-clipped competitor to lesson checks.
